name: lf11_04_zoning_cost_extension
description: Conformance test 4. A region intersecting a zone whose levelAltitude is 275, over cells at 270 and 280: no tolerance test, cost round(4 x (5 + 5)) = 40. With the second cell at 272 the variance (2) would pass the tolerance test on its own, but against the zone's 275 the cost is round(4 x (5 + 3)) = 32.
